environment.browser: Codex in-app browser against an isolated portal and Fake OmniRoute

evidence: 8 request-content logging and pending-user lifecycle tests passed after removing accidental imported-fixture test collection.
The logging client preserves existing OmniRoute database log settings and only enables callLogPipelineEnabled.
Request and final-response extraction retained a 120000-character body without truncation.
Successful resend replaced the old token only after SMTP delivery; failed delivery removed the new token and kept the old hash.
Pending-user deletion removed the registration and verification token, while verified-user deletion was rejected.
Audit storage preserved a 7000-character detail beyond the previous 2000-character limit.
44 frontend tests passed across 8 files.
Status copy distinguishes email verification, API Key creation, and permission synchronization.
Audit JSON formatting preserves long nested content and maps common internal actions to Chinese labels.
Pending-user resend and exact-email delete confirmation composable tests passed.
Stress selection contract contains a stable detail anchor, selected-state feedback, and scrollIntoView behavior.
Portal production build passed with 29 transformed modules.
10 control-plane upgrade package tests passed.
Built portal index SHA256: 171d66a38a8b636e245234101aa4accaf3b0366efdf9f945b48322c93baeaac7.
Built portal JavaScript SHA256: 2d0884a0e9621613397ed2cfe299fca040006204d40f5a321e58a9ca2ce45fc9.
Built portal CSS SHA256: ceb654822f1a5b47fefc6ba0e5f45c683381b0d6cbf72fef05ee02d19228a8da.
With a 500-pixel viewport, the sidebar remained sticky at 58 pixels, had overflow-y=auto, could scroll independently, and contained no redundant side-note card.
The pending user row displayed 邮箱未验证, 验证邮箱后自动创建, 等待邮箱验证, 补发验证邮件, and 删除未验证用户.
The delete dialog explained scope and impact; its destructive button remained disabled before the exact email was entered.
The audit page displayed 结算并同步用量 while retaining admin/billing/reconcile and expanded a 4101-character JSON detail including its tail.
Selecting a historical stress run produced one selected row and one 当前查看 button, then settled the result panel at 72 pixels below the viewport top.
The usage detail rendered four complete retained sections with lengths 13, 12009, 4000, and 12009 characters and showed both request and final response text.
238 Python tests passed in 47.422 seconds.
Python compilation and git diff whitespace checks passed.
style.css was split at the existing LLMCtl 2.6 theme boundary into 2123-line base styles and 1929-line operations-theme.css without changing import order.
All modified handwritten source files remained below 3000 physical lines; App.vue had 2972 lines and the existing account-portal integration test remained at 2995 lines.
OmniRoute 3.8.48 source confirms detailed capture is controlled by database setting logs.callLogPipelineEnabled and persists unified call-log artifacts with requestBody and responseBody.
The official database settings API supports authenticated GET/PATCH at /api/settings/database.
Router environment disables stream-chunk capture, raises the artifact ceiling to 4096 KiB, raises the text limit to 1048576 characters, and retains call summaries for 30 days.
